title: Quicunque vult, commonly called the Creed of Saint Athanasius

units.text: Upon theſe Feasts, Christmas-day, the Epiphany, St. Matthias, Easter-day, Aſcenſion-day, Whitſunday, St. John Baptist, St. James, St. Bartholomew, St. Matthew, St. Simon and St. Jude, St. Andrew, and upon Trinity-ſunday, ſhall be ſung or ſaid at Morning Prayer, instead of the Apostles Creed, this Confeſſion of our Christian Faith, commonly called the Creed of St. Athanaſius, by the Minister and people standing.

verses.first: WHOSOEVER will be ſaved
verses.second: before all things it is neceſſary that he hold the Catholick Faith.

verses.first: Which Faith except every one do keep whole and undefiled
verses.second: without doubt he ſhall periſh everlastingly.

verses.first: And the Catholick Faith is this
verses.second: That we worſhip one God in Trinity, and Trinity in Unity;

verses.first: Neither confounding the Perſons
verses.second: nor dividing the Substance.

verses.first: For there is one Perſon of the Father, another of the Son
verses.second: and another of the Holy Ghost.

verses.first: But the Godhead of the Father, of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost, is all one
verses.second: the Glory equal, the Majesty co-eternal.

verses.first: Such as the Father is, ſuch is the Son
verses.second: and ſuch is the Holy Ghost.

verses.first: The Father uncreate, the Son uncreate
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost uncreate.

verses.first: The Father incomprehenſible, the Son incomprehenſible
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost incomprehenſible.

verses.first: The Father eternal, the Son eternal
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost eternal.

verses.first: And yet there are not three eternals
verses.second: but one eternal.

verses.first: As alſo there are not three incomprehenſibles, nor three uncreated
verses.second: but one uncreated and one incomprehenſible.

verses.first: So likewiſe the Father is Almighty, the Son Almighty
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost Almighty.

verses.first: And yet there are not three Almighties
verses.second: but one Almighty.

verses.first: So the Father is God, the Son is God
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost is God.

verses.first: And yet there are not three Gods
verses.second: but one God.

verses.first: So likewiſe the Father is Lord, the Son Lord
verses.second: and the Holy Ghost Lord.

verses.first: And yet not three Lords
verses.second: but one Lord.

verses.first: For like as we are compelled by the Christian verity
verses.second: to acknowledge every Perſon by himſelf to be God and Lord;

verses.first: So are we forbidden by the Catholick Religion
verses.second: to ſay there be three Gods, or three Lords.

verses.first: The Father is made of none
verses.second: neither created, nor begotten.

verses.first: The Son is of the Father alone
verses.second: not made, nor created, but begotten.

verses.first: The Holy Ghost is of the Father and of the Son
verses.second: neither made, nor created, nor begotten, but proceeding.

verses.first: So there is one Father, not three Fathers; one Son, not three Sons
verses.second: one Holy Ghost, not three Holy Ghosts.

verses.first: And in this Trinity none is afore or after other
verses.second: none is greater, or leſs than another;

verses.first: But the whole three Perſons are co-eternal together
verses.second: and co-equal.

verses.first: So that in all things, as is aforeſaid
verses.second: the Unity in Trinity, and the Trinity in Unity is to be worſhipped.

verses.first: He therefore that will be ſaved
verses.second: must thus think of the Trinity.

verses.first: Furthermore, it is neceſſary to everlasting ſalvation
verses.second: that he alſo believe rightly the Incarnation of our Lord Jeſus Christ.

verses.first: For the right Faith is, that we believe and confeſs
verses.second: that our Lord Jeſus Christ, the Son of God, is God and Man;

verses.first: God, of the Substance of the Father, begotten before the worlds
verses.second: and Man, of the ſubstance of his Mother, born in the world;

verses.first: Perfect God, and perfect Man
verses.second: of a reaſonable ſoul and human fleſh ſubſisting;

verses.first: Equal to the Father, as touching his Godhead
verses.second: and inferior to the Father, as touching his Manhood;

verses.first: Who although he be God and Man
verses.second: yet he is not two, but one Christ;

verses.first: One; not by converſion of the Godhead into fleſh
verses.second: but by taking of the Manhood into God;

verses.first: One altogether; not by confuſion of Sub-stance
verses.second: but by unity of Perſon.

verses.first: For as the reaſonable ſoul and fleſh is one man
verses.second: ſo God and Man is one Christ;

verses.first: Who ſuffered for our ſalvation
verses.second: deſcended into hell; roſe again the third day from the dead;

verses.first: He aſcended into heaven, he ſitteth on the right hand of the Father, God Almighty
verses.second: from whence He ſhall come to judge the quick and the dead.

verses.first: At whoſe coming all men ſhall riſe again with their bodies
verses.second: and ſhall give account for their own works.

verses.first: And they that have done good ſhall go into life everlasting
verses.second: and they that have done evil, into everlasting fire.

verses.first: This is the Catholick Faith
verses.second: which except a man believe faithfully, he cannot be ſaved.

gloria.first: Glory be to the Father and to the Son
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever ſhall be
